skill.name: blocklet-updater
skill.description: Automates Blocklet release preparation by choosing a version bump method, validating output, running builds, and creating a release bundle.
skill.summary: Bump, build, validate, and bundle Blocklet projects for releases.
skill.author: ArcBlock

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are Markdown formatting or benign local file checks, not executable code in the skill package. Confirmed risks are the intended release actions that run project-controlled Makefile or package scripts, install dependencies, run builds, and create Blocklet release bundles.

remediation.issue: Project-defined release scripts can execute arbitrary local commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running Makefile, package.json, lerna, or pnpm scripts, and show the exact command first.

remediation.issue: Dependency install and build steps may run package lifecycle hooks.
remediation.suggestion: Document that untrusted repositories require isolation, or offer a sandboxed mode before running pnpm install and build commands.

remediation.issue: Silent finalization reduces visibility after release changes.
remediation.suggestion: Report changed files, version, output directory, and bundle path after successful completion.

finding_verdicts.reason: The workflow explicitly directs the agent to use an external Blocklet version command during release preparation. That command mutates project files, so it is a real operational risk even though it is intended behavior.

The fallback blocklet version command mutates project version metadata. It is intended behavior, but it is still external command execution with file-changing side effects.

content.value_statement: Blocklet releases require version updates, builds, metadata checks, and bundles. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through a repeatable release workflow.
actual_capabilities: Detects Makefile, package.json, lerna, and Blocklet version bump methods.
Runs the selected version bump command and stops on failure.
Checks changelog entries against blocklet.yml or package.json versions.
Runs dependency install and build commands when a build script exists.
Verifies index.html output and blocklet.yml main alignment.
Runs blocklet meta and creates a release bundle.
limitations: Runs local project commands, so users should review scripts before use.
Does not publish releases to external registries.
Requires Blocklet CLI and project tooling to be installed.
May need user input when commit history cannot produce changelog content.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Patch Release
use_cases.description: Bump a Blocklet version, build the project, and create a release bundle.

use_cases.title: Validate Release Output
use_cases.description: Check index.html output, blocklet.yml main alignment, and metadata before bundling.

use_cases.title: Repair Changelog Versions
use_cases.description: Match changelog headings to the actual version produced by the bump command.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Blocklet Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Bump and bundle this Blocklet project.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner release workflow from the project root.

prompt_templates.title: Patch Release With Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a patch release, run the build if needed, and stop if validation fails.
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard release workflow with failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Changelog And Main Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the version, verify changelog and blocklet.yml main, then create a release bundle.
prompt_templates.scenario: Release workflow that checks metadata and changelog consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Monorepo Release Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this monorepo for its release method, use the correct version command, repair changelog version mismatch, and bundle the Blocklet.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for repositories with custom release tooling.

output_examples.input: Bump and bundle this Blocklet project.
output_examples.output: The skill selects the release command, runs the build when present, validates metadata, and creates the release bundle.

output_examples.input: Create a release and fix the changelog if needed.
output_examples.output: The skill compares the actual version with the changelog, updates the heading when needed, and continues to bundle validation.

output_examples.input: Release this Blocklet from a monorepo.
output_examples.output: The skill checks project-specific release scripts, follows the first matching method, and verifies the Blocklet output directory.

best_practices: Review Makefile and package scripts before running the release workflow.
Commit or stash unrelated changes before starting a version bump.
Run the skill from the Blocklet project root.
anti_patterns: Do not run it on untrusted repositories without reviewing scripts.
Do not continue after dependency, build, metadata, or bundle errors.
Do not use it to publish a release without a separate release approval process.

faq.question: Does this skill publish a Blocklet?
faq.answer: No. It creates a release bundle but does not publish it to an external registry.

faq.question: What tools does it require?
faq.answer: It expects Blocklet CLI and common project tools such as pnpm, jq, git, make, or lerna when needed.

faq.question: Can it handle monorepos?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks Makefile targets, package scripts, lerna configuration, and common changelog paths.

faq.question: Will it edit project files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update versions, changelog entries, and the blocklet.yml main field.

faq.question: How does it choose the version command?
faq.answer: It follows the documented priority order and uses the first matching release method.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted repositories?
faq.answer: Use caution. Review scripts first because release and build commands can run project-controlled code.
